observation.command:
cd /workspace/project && DISPLAY=:99 timeout 200 python3 - <<'PY' 2>&1 | tail -30
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
import time
with sync_playwright() as p:
    b=p.chromium.launch(headless=False,args=["--no-sandbox"])
    pg=b.new_page()
    pg.goto("https://dash.allmodels.io/signup",wait_until="domcontentloaded")
    pg.wait_for_timeout(6000)
    ts=[f for f in pg.frames if "challenges.cloudflare.com" in f.url]
    print("turnstile frames:",len(ts))
    if ts:
        fr=ts[0]
        print("body html:", fr.evaluate("document.body.innerHTML")[:400])
        # klik checkbox
        for sel in ['input[type=checkbox]','label','#challenge-stage','body']:
            try:
                fr.click(sel, timeout=5000); print("klik OK:",sel); break
            except Exception as e: print("gagal:",sel,type(e).__name__)
    pg.wait_for_timeout(8000)
    print("token:", pg.eval_on_selector('input[name="cf-turnstile-response"]','e=>e.value')[:40])
    print("submit enabled:", not pg.is_disabled('button[type=submit]'))
    b.close()
